thread:
anya: Quick question on the p95 card layout — can we move sampling controls into the time scrubber area and show a condensed heatmap above it?
sam: doing that could free vertical space in the card. does condensed heatmap still show bucket counts on hover?
matt: mocked two variants: (A) thin inline heatmap embedded into the card header, (B) tiny dedicated heatmap above the scrubber with presets. attaching figs: https://figma.com/s/condensed-a and /b
anya: saw both. A feels lighter; B is clearer for presets. mobile constraints push me toward A.
leo: a11y nit: any touch target must be >=44px and have a visible focus ring. if inline, ensure we keep a large hit area for the sampler handle.
aria: color contrast: when the heatmap shrinks the mid-tone greens lose AA contrast. propose darker base colors and a 1px stroke on selected bucket.
katie: copy: prefer label 'Sampling rate' over 'Show sample'. tooltip idea: "Percent of requests shown to reduce noise in the view" — feedback?
sam: like that. also show a transient number overlay while dragging (e.g., "10%") so we don't clutter card.
matt: implementation notes: add a compact variant "mini-heatmap" in components, with keyboard affordances and aria-live updates for SR. example aria message: "Sampling set to 10 percent".
leo: keyboard interactions: tab to focus, arrows for 1% nudge, shift+arrow for 10% steps, home/end to jump to presets. announce deltas via aria-live to avoid spam.
aria: screen reader mapping for heatmap: avoid exposing each bucket as separate focusable element when there are many. offer a single "Bucket list" listbox that cycles through buckets on request and reads counts.
anya: agree — single control that opens a bucket list is cleaner. for sighted users, hover shows counts inline. compact mode hides labels.
katie: microcopy tweak: change tooltip to "Reduce noise so latency patterns are easier to see." shorter and action oriented.
sam: presets: 1%, 10%, 100% as quick toggles. add a subtle divider between presets and custom drag.
matt: dev handoff checklist: focus tokens, 44px hit area, color tokens, aria-live region, keyboard spec, figma updates. I'll update mocks and add dev notes.
anya: next steps: matt updates figma + tokens, leo/aria run quick keyboard & SR smoke tests on prototype, katie finalizes copy.
prod-bot: preview deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/mini-heatmap-sampler (expires in 48h)
anya: cool — let's run a 5-min usability check with 3 folks once the preview is live. thanks all :thumbsup:
